description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: small floating rock chunk with grass on top, white marble cloud pillar, wind chime arch, broken bird statue, carved wind spiral stone, cloud-shaped marble bench, feather totem pole, cracked sky temple column, glowing wind rune stone, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
